name: BMC Medical Co., Ltd.
summary: BMC Medical Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and supplies medical equipment and consumable in the field of respiratory health in China and internationally. The company offers home-use non-invasive ventilators, ventilation masks, sleep monitors, high-flow humidified oxygen therapy devices, and oxygen concentrators. It also provides chronic disease management services for respiratory health. BMC Medical Co., Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is based in Beijing, China.
